title: Dynamic Programming
definition: DP solves complex problems by breaking them down into overlapping subproblems, storing results to avoid redundant work.
intuition: Remember past answers to solve future calculations quickly.
how_it_works: Can be Top-down (Memoization) or Bottom-up (Tabulation) based on state-transitions.
when_to_use: When problems exhibit overlapping subproblems and optimal substructure.
when_not_to_use: When subproblems do not overlap (use standard divide-and-conquer).
complexity: Time: O(number of states * transition time)
content: DP solves complex problems by breaking them down into overlapping subproblems, storing results to avoid redundant work.
